args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Covey & Lark Retail was renamed Pellow Home Living on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" now matches two businesses, so filtering on it returns both Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so it still uses the old name.
- On 17 Feb the saved retail view was relabelled with the full name, and the terminal view was to be fixed. We have no confirmation that either was finished.

Could you confirm which saved reports and views still use the old name or the bare "PHL" label, and who will update them?

Thanks,
Bettina
